source_refs.note: Spacetime Distortion / Tidal Forces: a main subheading of 8.6 Gravitational waves (GWs), its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 183-186.

blocks.text: Mass wale object se guzarne wali gravitational waves object ko baar baar khinchne aur dabne par majboor karti hain; isay “spacetime distortion” kehte hain. Is effect ko “tidal forces” bhi kehte hain aur yeh wave ke oscillating (jhoolne) ki wajah se hai. Wave object ke ird-gird spacetime ko jhulati hai, jis se object wave ki direction ke perpendicular baar baar khinchta aur dabta hai. Yeh waisa hi hai jaise Chand aur Suraj ki gravitational pull (kashish) se Zameen par samandar mein tides (madd-o-jazar) aate hain.

blocks.alt: Kaale pas-manzar par feroza khanon wali chadar ek gehre gaddhe (funnel) mein jhukti hai; gaddhe mein Zameen hai aur baen oopar neele solar panels wala satellite urr raha hai.
blocks.caption: Ek artificial (insaan ka banaya hua) aur ek natural satellite ke saath spacetime ka curve (jhukao) (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: Four rings of small masses at t = 0, T/4, T/2 and 3T/4 as a gravitational wave passes into the page: a circle, an ellipse stretched sideways and squeezed vertically, a circle again, and an ellipse stretched vertically and squeezed sideways.
blocks.caption: Guzarti gravitational wave mein azad masses ka daira khinchta aur dabta hai (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Wave page ke andar ja rahi hai. Us ki direction ke perpendicular plane mein object ek taraf khinchta aur doosri taraf dabta hai, phir aadhe period baad ulta. Yahi baar baar khinchao aur dabao (tidal effect) hai.
Stretching aur compressing ki amount wave ki strength (taqat) aur object ke mass aur size par depend karti hai. Yeh effect Einstein ki general relativity ki ek important prediction hai.

Door ke celestial (falaki, aasmani) events, jaise do black holes ya neutron stars ke merger, ki waves Zameen se bhi guzarti hain. Lekin in ka amplitude bohat chhota hai (strain taqreeban 10⁻²¹ se 10⁻²²), is liye in se hone wali tabdeeli bohat hi chhoti hai aur extremely sensitive (bohat hassas) instruments chahiye.

blocks.alt: Kaale pas-manzar par safed khanon wali chadar beech ke bare surmai gole ke neeche jhukti hai; baen taraf chhota surmai gola, jis ka mura hua safed teer bare gole ke gird us ka raasta dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Do satellites ke zariye dikhaya gaya spacetime ka curve (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab amplitude ko “10⁻²¹ to 10⁻²² metres” likhti hai. Gravitational wave ka amplitude strain hai, yani length mein fractional tabdeeli (ΔL/L), jis ka koi unit nahi. LIGO ke 4 km lambe arms mein yeh tabdeeli sirf taqreeban 10⁻¹⁸ m hoti hai (4000 m × 10⁻²¹).

Chhote amplitude ke bawajood gravitational waves universe ko dekhne ka unique (anokha) darwaza hain: in se strong-field gravity (bohat taqatwar gravity) parhi ja sakti hai, general relativity ko test kiya ja sakta hai, aur universe ko un tareeqon se dekha ja sakta hai jo pehle mumkin nahi the.

blocks.prompt: Gravitational waves kya hain, kis ne un ki prediction ki, aur tidal forces kaise bante hain (MCQ 8.10, 8.11, 8.13; constructed response 8.6)?
blocks.explanation: Gravitational waves spacetime mein waves hain jin ki prediction Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein general relativity se ki; yeh zyada tar accelerate karte bhaari objects, jaise black holes ke merger, se paida hoti hain. Jab wave kisi object se guzarti hai to us ke gird spacetime ko jhulati hai, to object wave ki direction ke perpendicular baar baar khinchta aur dabta hai; yahi tidal forces hain, jaise Chand aur Suraj Zameen par tides banate hain.

items: Gravitational waves: violent cosmic events se spacetime mein waves, light ki speed se; Einstein ki 1916 ki prediction; pehli detection 2015 (do black holes ka merger).
Chaar types: continuous, compact binary inspiral, burst, stochastic. Binary systems sab se bare sources hain; waves mass, spin aur merger ki information laati hain.
Tidal forces: guzarti wave object ko us ki direction ke perpendicular khinchti aur dabati hai; strain sirf 10⁻²¹ ke qareeb, is liye LIGO jaise sensitive instruments chahiye.
